title: Exploring Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Steerable Pluralistic Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to steer its responses to reflect the majority perspective of various U.S. demographic groups (e.g., age, gender) by predicting multiple-choice survey answers from the OpinionQA dataset.

Measuring the model's capacity to adopt specific political ideologies (e.g., liberal vs. conservative) using public survey questions from the OpinionQA dataset and comparing the outputs against actual human response distributions.

Testing the model's capacity to adopt and reason through specific ethical or moral perspectives (e.g., minimizing harm vs. autonomy) to support or oppose hypothetical scenarios using the Value Kaleidoscope dataset.
